changed_path.description:
A path with a git status, relative to its worktree, with `/` between the
names. A folder that git reports as a whole, such as an ignored or an
untracked folder, ends with `/`.

create_project.description: Makes a project: a new, empty folder directly in the projects root.

name.description:
The name of the folder: one name that each system accepts, which does
not start with a dot.

done.description: The answer of a request that has no value.

code.description:
The kind of an error: `notFound`, the path does not exist;
`permissionDenied`, the path is outside the roots that the engine can
reach; `invalidArgument`, the request is not valid, for example a relative
path; `failedPrecondition`, the state does not let the request occur, for
example git is missing. The variants have no doc comments of their own,
so that the schema keeps them as one plain enum.

hello.description: Starts a connection with the protocol version of the client.

list_directory.description:
Lists one folder of a worktree. The engine reads only this folder, so that
a large tree, such as `node_modules`, costs nothing until the user opens it.

path.description:
The folder, relative to the worktree, with `/` between the names.
An empty path is the worktree itself.

worktree.description: The absolute path of the worktree.

list_projects.description: Lists the projects: the folders directly in the projects root.

open_folder.description:
Opens a folder: a git repository, or a plain folder.
The engine adds the folder, and each worktree of its repository, to the
roots that later requests can reach (core value 6).

path.description: An absolute path on the machine of the engine.

project.description: A folder directly in the projects root.

git.description: True when the folder has a `.git` entry.

read_status.description: Reads the git status of a worktree.

worktree.description: The absolute path of the worktree.

repository.description: A repository and its worktrees, or a plain folder as one worktree.

git.description: False for a plain folder, which has no git status.

name.description: The name of the folder of the main worktree.

branch.description:
The checked-out branch, without `refs/heads/`. None when the HEAD is
detached, or for a plain folder.

current.description: True for the worktree of the opened folder.

path.description: The absolute path of the worktree.

request.description: A request to the engine: its method, and its params.

oneOf.description: The first request of a connection. Answers [`Welcome`].

params.description: Starts a connection with the protocol version of the client.

oneOf.description: Answers each [`Project`] in the projects root.

params.description: Lists the projects: the folders directly in the projects root.

oneOf.description: Makes a folder in the projects root. Answers its [`Project`].

params.description: Makes a project: a new, empty folder directly in the projects root.

name.description:
The name of the folder: one name that each system accepts, which does
not start with a dot.

params.description:
Opens a folder: a git repository, or a plain folder.
The engine adds the folder, and each worktree of its repository, to the
roots that later requests can reach (core value 6).

path.description: An absolute path on the machine of the engine.

params.description:
Lists one folder of a worktree. The engine reads only this folder, so that
a large tree, such as `node_modules`, costs nothing until the user opens it.

path.description:
The folder, relative to the worktree, with `/` between the names.
An empty path is the worktree itself.

worktree.description: The absolute path of the worktree.

params.description: Reads the git status of a worktree.

worktree.description: The absolute path of the worktree.

oneOf.description:
Stops the engine process. Answers [`Done`], then the process stops.
It is valid before `hello`, and its shape never changes, so that each
app can stop an engine of an older version.

welcome.description: The answer to [`Hello`] when the engine speaks the protocol of the client.

root.description: The absolute path of the projects root.
